scope: CPU arithmetic of archived Wan measurements plus separately labeled synthetic identities. Held update ratios measure the implemented recovery and final BF16 writeback on H, relative to the base update on H; they are not norms of an H-only recovery operator.

held_update_energy_after_to_before_fit.numerator: Squared centered-minus-raw attention output norm on H, after fitted recovery, final BF16 conversion, and P overwrite.
held_update_energy_after_to_before_fit.denominator: Squared centered-minus-raw base norm on H, from FP32 base fields that already contain the respective quantized anchor histories.
held_update_energy_after_to_before_fit.dependency: The fitted correction depends on P64 labels; H is the measurement subset, not a closed input space for the recovery operator.
held_update_energy_after_to_before_fit.interpretation: Realized direction energy ratio of recovery plus final writeback; not an isolated real-arithmetic L norm, projection fraction, or spectral estimate.

measurement_scope.raw_fit_to_base_energy: Actual raw error after fitted recovery and final BF16 writeback over raw base error, both measured on H.
measurement_scope.centered_fit_to_base_energy: Actual centered error after fitted recovery and final BF16 writeback over centered base error, both measured on H.
measurement_scope.implementation_identity_check: Source compare_shadow verifies L times the actual base difference before final BF16 conversion; FP32 arithmetic rounding is still present.
measurement_scope.ideal_mean_scale_decomposition: rho times mean change plus C_a times scale change uses one unquantized ideal anchor with no support truncation; actual base differences also contain separate raw and centered encoding errors.

synthetic.scope: Synthetic real-arithmetic witnesses with every scale column active; no BF16 cache quantization, threshold truncation, or candidate model run
